subject.title: [Bug]: Tool stdout leaks to chat + reply generation interrupted

question: What command-output visibility boundary should OpenClaw enforce for external chats when verbose/full is enabled, and should this issue's final-response half remain owned by the replay-safety policy work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657?
rationale: The source evidence shows existing documented debug output behavior and existing fail-closed replay safety; changing either boundary can expose or suppress tool data, or replay side effects, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Split policy and replay work
options.body: Keep verbose/full as an explicit debug surface, add a typed way to suppress internal-script/status stdout from external chat, and leave replay-unsafe post-tool recovery to the canonical incomplete-turn issue.

options.title: Suppress all command stdout in channels
options.body: Make external chats final-answer-only for command output, accepting a breaking change to documented verbose/full debugging behavior.

options.title: Close as expected verbose behavior
options.body: Treat stdout visibility under verbose/full as working as documented and only track the incomplete-turn half elsewhere, leaving reporters without a narrower internal-output boundary.

recommendation.title: Split policy and replay work
recommendation.body: Keep verbose/full as an explicit debug surface, add a typed way to suppress internal-script/status stdout from external chat, and leave replay-unsafe post-tool recovery to the canonical incomplete-turn issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the verbose tool feedback surface and merged the adjacent replay-safety changes, so he is the best routed owner for the combined security/product boundary decision.
